historia.texto: Logo no começo, o Eddie disse que uma coisa pesava na cabeça dele havia três semanas, pediu desculpas ao público e agradeceu, dizendo que a energia que recebeu ajudou na recuperação. Depois de Can't Deny Me, anunciou que o povo tinha falado: deixa o Stone cantar. O Stone assumiu Mankind, a música desandou no fim e ele desistiu, rindo que devia ser por isso que o Eddie não deixa ele cantar. A plateia pediu o Jeff, que alegou dor de garganta. Em Rearviewmirror, com o público apertado na frente, o Eddie fez a banda baixar o volume, pediu três passos pra trás contados até três e só então terminaram a música no volume máximo. No bis teve bolo pro chef Sam e pro Stone, que levou o bolo na cara. Com a banda já fora do palco, todos voltaram pra All Along the Watchtower.
historia.rotuloFonte: Fanviews do fórum oficial do Pearl Jam

fontes.trecho: This has been weighing on my mind for the last three weeks.  I just want to offer my deepest apology to all of you, and thank you guys, the band and crew.  The energy you gave me helped with the recovery.
Ed says “The people have spoken, and they said (sotto voce) “Sweet Lew,” no, "Let Stone sing!"  So, ladies and gentlemen, Stone Gossard.
Towards the end the song falls apart and Stone gives up.  “This is probably why Ed doesn’t let me sing..)
Eventually the crowd starts chanting “Let Jeff sing.” Jeff seems interested but Ed says  “Jeff won’t be singing tonight.” Jeff pipes up, “I have a sore throat!”

Because of the press of the crowd Ed asks Kille to turn up the lights so he can see and asks the band to slow down.  The band slows and gets quiet. EV implores the audience to take three steps back on the count of three.
When things are calm the band finishes the song at full speed and volume)

One is the bands chef, Sam, who is brought on stage and the other is Stone Gossard who is having a birthday shortly after the tour.  Ed gets the audience to sing them Happy Birthday and the cake is mashed into Stone and Sam.
Although the band had left minutes ago they come back to play one more song.)
